definitions.species: Reference taxid_species of the aligner LCA; unresolved above-species evidence remains separate.
definitions.threshold: Added reporting rule at 2, 3, 5 joint exemplars, applied equally to both arms.
definitions.validation: No-alignment denominator is aligned + no_alignment; agreement and mean distance use rows with numeric aligner distance, pooled with those row counts as weights.
definitions.runtime: Workflow elapsed is finished-start; allocation-hours=sum(realtime*allocated cpus/3600). Rounded Nextflow realtime values limit precision. Variant prepare/protein cpus are resolved from frozen process declarations and runtime.config because those trace schemas omit cpus.
definitions.scope: Nested depth strata remain separate. New NR audit does not modify these pipeline outputs.
